versions.subject: Create proc_creation_win_reg_import_from_suspicious_paths.yml
versions.detection:
selection_root:
    Image|endswith: '\reg.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' import '
selection_paths:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'C:\Users\'
        - '%temp%'
        - '%appdata%'
        - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
        - 'C:\Windows\Temp\'
        - 'C:\ProgramData\'
condition: all of selection_*
